name: Stormwitch Staff's proc dummies trigger Thunderstrike on direct magic damage (#11308)
contract: Stormwitch Staff's equip spell 303052 and its tier dummies 312855/316855/320855 are passive aura 42 (proc trigger spell) records triggering Thunderstrike 303001/312856/316856/320856. Their Spell.dbc records carry ProcFlags 0 and the world had no spell_proc row, so Aura::GetProcEffectMask found no proc entry and the tooltip's roll on dealing direct magic damage never ran (#11308). The repair grants PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_MAGIC_DMG_CLASS_NEG at the hit phase over every school and spell family and defers Chance to each record's own ProcChance (5 for the base staff, 10 for the tiers). spell_proc_chance reads those loaded entries, and aura_proc_rate replays the aura's native proc decision 40000 times per sample on a synthetic landed magic-class direct hit naming Frostbolt 116; melee-class and periodic events proc it zero times. Before the repair the chance lookups fail with 'Spell has no proc entry' and every rate reads 0, so the discriminating assertions fail rather than flake.
